text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report requests that Scarborough Community Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 83 Treetops Court. The application indicates the reason for removal is to address concerns that the tree's needles and limbs are blocking the eaves troughs and causing damage to the roof, and that the tree's leaking sap is damaging parked vehicles. The subject tree is an Austrian pine tree (Pinus nigra) measuring 46 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Denied the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 83 Treetops Court.
